title: THE LAW
OF PROVISION
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: glowing embers in a stone hearth

scenes.a: The financial tension holding your chest tight right now is exactly where God is working.
Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom.
For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
Lord, help me trust this holy cycle of stewardship today.
Release the fear of scarcity and replace it with your promise of overflow.
May every decision I make reflect your kingdom principles of generous, faithful provision.
